name: Alan Wake Origins Bundle
summary:
Alan Wake Origins Bundle brings together the complete foundation of Remedy Entertainment’s cult-classic psychological thriller franchise. Step into the mind of troubled writer Alan Wake and experience the story where it all began—dark, atmospheric, and unforgettable.

This bundle includes:

• Alan Wake – The original award-winning psychological action thriller. Explore the small town of Bright Falls, use light as your weapon, and uncover a mystery written in darkness.

• Alan Wake’s American Nightmare – A standalone sequel that expands the lore with a faster-paced, arcade-style experience, new enemies, and deeper insight into the Dark Place.

• Alan Wake Collector’s Edition Extras – A curated collection of bonus content, including soundtrack material and additional extras that enrich the Alan Wake universe.

Featuring cinematic storytelling, third-person action, and intense atmosphere, the Alan Wake Origins Bundle is the definitive way to experience the early chapters of the franchise. Whether you are returning to Bright Falls or discovering it for the first time, this bundle offers the essential Alan Wake experience in one complete package.
